attchmntText: Som Distilleries & Breweries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Som Distilleries and Breweries Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 13th November 2026. The Board approved the Un-Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. This approval includes the Limited Review Report from Statutory Auditors for the corresponding period. The meeting commenced at 3.30 p.m. and concluded at 5.30 p.m. The financial results will be published in newspapers and uploaded to the websites of the National Stock Exchange of India, BSE Limited, and the company.

attchmntText: Som Distilleries & Breweries Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Som Distilleries and Breweries Limited has rescheduled its Q2 and H1 FY 2026-27 earnings conference call. The event, originally set for 4:00 PM IST on 16th November 2026, is now scheduled for 5:30 PM IST on the same date. The call will discuss financial results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. This follows the announcement of results on 13th November 2026. Management representatives include Mr. Diwakaran Suryanarayana and Mr. Nakul Sethi. Dial-in details are available on the company website.

attchmntText: Som Distilleries & Breweries Limited has informed the Exchange about Commencement of commercial production/operations
voiceSummary: SOM Distilleries and Breweries Limited has commenced production and dispatches from its Bhopal manufacturing facility. The company will progressively ramp up production and dispatches in line with market demand. This development marks a milestone in the restoration of the company's business operations and growth trajectory. The information was disclosed pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The announcement was signed by Nakul Kam Sethi, Whole Time Director, with DIN 06512548. The details are available on the company website at www.somindia.com.

voiceSummary: Som Distilleries and Breweries Limited has intimated that its Q2 and H1 FY 2026-27 Earnings Conference Call is scheduled for Monday, 16th November, 2026, at 4:00 P.M. IST. The call will discuss financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. The results were announced on Friday, 13th November, 2026. Management representatives include Mr. Diwakaran Suryanarayana, Chief Operating Officer, and Mr. Nakul Sethi, Whole-Time Director, Finance and Strategy. The event includes an interactive question and answer session. Details are available on the company website.
